Seven fishermen rescued after boat capsizes off Tuticorin coast

Seven fishermen were rescued after their boat capsized off the coast of Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu. The incident occurred near the Tuticorin coast. All seven fishermen on board were brought to safety. No casualties were reported.
